name: ipu-asm
description: Language support for IPU VLIW assembly (.asm, .asm.j2 templates): highlighting, completion, operand hints, hover docs, navigation, formatting and live assembler errors. In the IPU emulator repository it also adds Run, Debug, Test and Benchmark buttons and a kernel sidebar.

commands.title: IPU Assembly: Why are diagnostics not running?

ipuAsm.checkCommand.markdownDescription: Command used to check a file, as an argv array; the file path is appended. Empty builds `//src/tools/ipu-as-py:ipu-as` once and runs that binary directly, falling back to `bazel run` whenever the assembler's sources are newer than it. Set this to point at a virtualenv to bypass Bazel entirely.

ipuAsm.bazelFlags.markdownDescription: Extra Bazel flags for Run, Debug, Test and Benchmark, e.g. `["--define=ipu_proto=1"]` for prototyping mode.

base.description: The registry case it starts from (its prepare and its options); a registry case's own name edits that case.

options.description: Option values over the base case's defaults.

ipuAsm.cases.markdownDescription: Cases saved from the case form (**IPU: Kernel Cases…**), by kernel: `{ "identity": { "tall": { "base": "default", "options": { "rows": 64 } } } }`. Each runs as `--case <base>` with its options. The registry's `cases.py` is never written.

ipuAsm.manifestCommand.markdownDescription: Command that prints the kernel manifest (JSON), as an argv array. Empty runs `bazel run //src/tools/ipu-apps:kernel_manifest`. The kernel buttons and the IPU sidebar are built from it.

ipuAsm.queryCommand.markdownDescription: Command for **IPU: Query**, as an argv array; `--json`, the operation and its `name=value` parameters are appended. Empty runs the manifest's query target through `bazel run`.

ipuAsm.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: The longest, in seconds, that the checker, the kernel manifest or a query may run before it is stopped; `0` means no limit. A `bazel run` waits for the workspace lock, so without a limit a build running in a terminal could hold a check or a rename indefinitely.

enumDescriptions: Empty space before each `;;` word, on screen only: the file keeps its rows. (Uses the editor's CodeLens row, so `editor.codeLens` must be on.)
An empty line between `;;` words, written by Format Document and by Enter after `;;`. Adds rows to the file.
A thin line drawn under each `;;` word, on screen only. Its colour is `ipuAsm.wordSeparator`.

ipuAsm.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Check each file with the assembler as you type and show its errors in Problems.

ipuAsm.hover.markdownDescription: Hover: an instruction's reference, a register's role, a Jinja name's value.

ipuAsm.completion.markdownDescription: Completion: mnemonics at an instruction start, what an operand accepts at an operand.

ipuAsm.operandHints.markdownDescription: Operand hints (signature help) while typing an instruction's operands.

ipuAsm.jinjaValueHints.markdownDescription: Show the literal value of a `set` name after each `{{ name }}` that reads it: `{{ lr_row }}` lr1.

ipuAsm.unusedNames.markdownDescription: Fade a label nothing branches to and a `set` name nothing reads.

ipuAsm.navigation.markdownDescription: Go to Definition, Find References and Rename for labels and Jinja names.

ipuAsm.outline.markdownDescription: Labels, `set` and `macro` names in the Outline and breadcrumbs.

ipuAsm.folding.markdownDescription: Fold multi-line `{# #}` comments and `{% tag %} … {% endtag %}` blocks.

ipuAsm.formatting.markdownDescription: Format Document and format on type (`;`, `:`, Enter). Typing alone is also `editor.formatOnType`.

ipuAsm.kernelButtons.markdownDescription: Run, Debug, Test and Benchmark buttons in the title bar of a kernel's `.asm`.

ipuAsm.sidebar.markdownDescription: The IPU sidebar: kernels, cases and query.
